answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each task slot needs a 25-unit escrow deposit: an island courier, an ember kiln tender, and an umber dye maker each take one slot and reclaim it only after real work. A rotating jury audits finished work; proven fakes lose the whole deposit, burned, not recycled. Faking 1,000 slots costs 25,000 units, far above one reward, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted fees.
